items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: DID YOU HAVE TIME WHEN YOU CAME UP TO SEE ME AT COLUMBIA, EARLY 1960's, 1961, 1962. I have some in there now, Al Vernon.

ctx.x: He had a sweet style and then he could scat too. Everybody worshipped him. He was suave and beautifully dressed, he was every bit of dignity and he was dressed like mad.
ALL OF YOU GUYS. THAT WAS ONE OF THE FEATURES OF YOUR BAND. YOU HAD TO BE JUST ABOUT THE BEST BAND IN THE BUSINESS.
